units: <cite ref="Shabbat 73b:4">Sabb. 73ᵇ</cite> <he>האי מאן דקַנֵּיב סלקא</he> (or <he>דקָנֵיב</he>) he who trims beets (in the ground).
<cite ref="Shabbat 115a:1">Ib. 115ᵃ</cite> <he>מְקַנְּבֵי כרבא</he> cleaned cabbage (on the Day of Atonement towards evening).—V. <cite ref="S00415"><he>קוּנְבִּיתָא</he></cite>.
